results.title: Destinations must move away from volume-driven expansion towards personalised marketing strategies, says Switzerland Tourism CEO
results.content: Martin Nydegger says Switzerland Tourism is expanding its strategic focus on south India, adding that holidaymakers and business travellers from Karnataka and the rest of south India account for 14.1% and 28.4%, respectively, of the tourism authority’s market

results.title: Watch: Amit Shah says Rahul Gandhi’s criticism of Modi abroad will not bring him to power
results.content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah criticised Rahul Gandhi for allegedly defaming India and Prime Minister Narendra Modi on international platforms. He urged Gandhi to visit Indian villages instead of travelling abroad and called on voters to respond in the upcoming elections.
